sources: A Curio Class game, made outside this repository and brought in 2026-11-24 as a single file with no build. source/cargo-hold.html is that file untouched; src.html is the game with our changes, bundled into sliding-blocks.html.

Classic sliding-block rules (public domain; L. W. Hardy's US patent 1,017,752, 1912, long expired). All 38 holds, their names and the art are the game's own; every hold's fewest-slides number was checked by a breadth-first search on 2026-11-24 and all 38 matched.
No image, sound or font files: everything is drawn in code, sounds are made in the browser, and the text uses fonts already on the device
